verdict.rationale: UK Visas and Immigration is a government immigration service for visa applications, eVisas, ETAs and processing-time lookups. It is not an AI agent or assistant that could act as an MCP client, so plugging in MCP servers to use their tools is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any agentic or MCP-client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
